description: Replace all @@instance/Singleton class variables with dependency injection. Files affected: models.cr (30 hits), event_broadcaster (29), monitoring (29), task_metadata (28), favicon_cache (22), memory_budget (15), singleton.cr (15), fiber_tracker (14), rate_limiter (14), color_extractor (14), gc_collector (13), clustering_service (12). Architecture doc: 'Global state - shared mutable state between modules' is a red flag. This causes race conditions and makes modules untestable in isolation.
title: Eliminate global state and singletons
